// diagnostic E0121

Jet.UseAfterMove

`{name}` was consumed by {consumer}, so it can't be used here

What

`{name}` was consumed by {consumer}, so it can't be used here

Why

After a value moves somewhere else, its old name no longer gives access to it

Fix

Stop using `{name}` after the move, or give {consumer} a copy with `{name}.copy()` where it moved.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UseAfterMove: Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.stderr.

Error: Jet.UseAfterMove: `batch` was consumed by `core.data.arrow.import`, so it can't be used here
  --> Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.jet:5:18
    |
  5 |     arrow.import(batch)
    |                  ^^^^^
  --> Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.jet:4:26
    |
  4 |     _moved: arrow.import(batch)
    |                          ^^^^^ `batch` moved to `core.data.arrow.import` here
 Why: After a value moves somewhere else, its old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: Stop using `batch` after the move, or give `core.data.arrow.import` a copy with `batch.copy()` where it moved.
